item.title: [−1] 10-year G-Sec yield jumps 10 bps to 7.40% as RBI rupee steps drain bank liquidity
item.description:
Up from 7.29% last week and 7.19% before the rate hike. Experts warn tighter liquidity and borrowing costs could slow credit growth. Escalating.

Capital goods & infra: mild headwind (−1) — Project borrowing dearer

Why it matters: Rupee-defence measures that tie up bank cash push up short and long rates, raising borrowing costs for government, companies and home buyers.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) −2, Growth outlook −1, Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
